svg.title: Linear state-space flow
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Negative eigenvalue real parts produce decay toward the fixed point while off-diagonal terms generate rotation. The plotted object is generated from dx/dt = A x. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Equation-driven dynamical-systems map. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
